crossRefs.note: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”
the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken…

translations.web: Go near, and hear all that Yahweh our God shall say, and tell us all that Yahweh our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”
translations.bsb: Go near and listen to all that the LORD our God says. Then you can tell us everything the LORD our God tells you; we will listen and obey.”
translations.kjv: Go thou near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that the LORD our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do
translations.asv: Go thou near, and hear all that Jehovah our God shall say: and speak thou unto us all that Jehovah our God shall speak unto thee; and we will hear it, and do it.
